uncommitted_source_change_scope: Current source checkout is audited directly; comparison normalizes only the copied build board-selection line.
provenance_scope: Manual build exports compared with current firmware source and copied build inputs; no cryptographic source-to-binary attestation.

physical_board_acceptance.confirmation_question: Have all five rebuilt 1.1.45 boards passed hardware testing, including video-loop preview and offline playback with the serial monitor closed, USB setup/app connection, and SD playback and saving?
physical_board_acceptance.scope: All five rebuilt 1.1.45 boards; hardware testing including closed-monitor video-loop preview and offline playback, USB setup/app connection, SD playback and saving.

credential_free_build_evidence.configuration_path: Empty initial Wi-Fi credentials, configured at runtime through USB and stored in device NVS.
credential_free_build_evidence.fresh_application_export_scope: Current requested-version linked application and supplied ELF match; this does not assert every unchanged translation unit was recompiled.
credential_free_build_evidence.object_reuse_assessment: Older unchanged objects are retained with copied-source and dependency correspondence evidence; the 180-second threshold alone does not establish reuse because compilation/linking may exceed three minutes.
credential_free_build_evidence.limitation: A successful build/package and source inspection are not cryptographic proof of credential absence. No secrets.h was read. Any reused objects retain copied source/dependency comparison evidence.

source_comparison.normalization: CRLF to LF; remove compiler #line directives; trim trailing whitespace/outer blank lines; remove generated setup/loop declarations in .ino.cpp; ignore only board selection in FirmwareTarget.h.

application_descriptor.descriptor_version_scope: Arduino-generated application descriptor identifier, separate from ESP_IMAGE_DISPLAY_FIRMWARE_VERSION exposed by USB identity.

build_evidence.compile_result_interpretation: Arduino Maker Workshop 1.1.11 writes false on source/profile changes as an upload-readiness invalidation, as well as compile failure. Exact trigger is not logged here. A false value alone does not demonstrate failure of the selected export; supplied ELF/BIN/source/object correspondence and maintainer acceptance are recorded independently.
build_evidence.compile_result_semantics_source: Installed Arduino Maker Workshop 1.1.11 build/extension.js: setBuildResult(false) in source change/file watcher and active profile fingerprint paths.

hardware_free_tests.verification_scope: Release tooling and desktop package validation/discovery, mocked CYD installation flow, and USB identity tests. No firmware or installer was built; no hardware was flashed or accessed. These results do not establish physical-board acceptance.
